subject: MAP: BrightKart prompt-pack transfer, escrow & acceptance runway
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightkart.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: eval-team@brightkart.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP & dataset handoff for BrightKart pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile. We'd like to start a short pilot focused on search relevance (query reformulation + reranking). Before we begin, legal wants a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines:

- what BrightKart will share (prompt packs + 5k test cases),
- what Redwood will provide (ephemeral sandbox + model variants),
- acceptance gates and data usage constraints (no external redistribution, ephemeral retention), and
- the target close timeline for the pilot (we're hoping for a 4-week runway starting Jul 5).

I've attached a zipped prompt pack (v3) and a short usage matrix for our internal reviewers. Can your team confirm the acceptable MAP template and any escrow requirements?

Also copying our evaluation lead so they can coordinate ingest.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. Product Manager, BrightKart
elena.morales@brightkart.com

Attachment: BrightKart_promptpack_v3.zip (32 files, .jsonl/.txt)
Attachment: usage_matrix_BK.xlsx

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightkart.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & dataset handoff for BrightKart pilot

Hi Elena — great to hear you're ready to move forward. Quick notes and next steps: 

- Thanks for the prompt pack and usage matrix. We'll confirm internal ingestion checks (formats + PII scan) by EOD tomorrow.
- Redwood is comfortable with an ephemeral sandbox for 4 weeks; we propose the following MAP checkpoints: kickoff, ingest & QA (week 1), limited-run evaluation (week 2–3), acceptance review & close (week 4).
- For data handling we require:
  * dataset to be stored in a customer-scoped bucket with restricted access,
  * automatic KV/prefix caching disabled for any testcases that contain PII (we'll run the scan),
  * retention of exchanged assets only for the pilot period unless otherwise agreed.

Markus (legal/ops), can you confirm whether our standard ephemeral-consignment clause is sufficient, or if BrightKart needs escrowed access to the prompt-pack? Marissa — I'll need your team to draft the MAP PDF with the timeline and acceptance criteria.

Proposed timeline: kickoff on 2027-07-05, pilot close 2027-07-30. If BrightKart needs faster turnaround we'll prioritize week 1 ingestion.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: (none)

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightkart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & dataset handoff for BrightKart pilot

Elena / Hannah — quick legal/ops input:

- Redwood can accept the prompt-pack under our standard "ephemeral-consignment" template. That template limits use to the pilot, prohibits redistribution, and requires certified deletion after the retention window.
- If BrightKart insists on escrowed storage, we can support a controlled escrow (third-party) but will need:
  * explicit retention schedule in the MAP,
  * an acceptance sign-off clause tied to the pilot's key metrics (MAP will include a pass/fail matrix), and
  * an SSO-enabled access list for any escrow activations.

- For the acceptance matrix: please confirm 3–4 target signals (e.g., MAP@k, MRR uplift signal, latency delta < 15ms) and we'll bake that into the MAP.

I've attached a blank MAP-draft that Marissa can populate.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Product Ops — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MAP-draft-BK-20270621.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightkart.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP & onboarding runway (draft) — BrightKart

Hi all — attaching the MAP draft and a compact onboarding checklist. Highlights: 

- Ingest checklist (week 1): file format validation (.jsonl), PII scan results attached, scoped bucket + IAM list.
- Evaluation cadence: week 2 exploratory runs (10k tokens/day), week 3 controlled testcases + A/B, week 4 acceptance review and artifact handoff.
- Usage constraints (explicit in section 3): no redistribution, no model fine-tuning on raw exchanged assets, deletion within 7 days after the pilot unless extended.
- Escrow option: appendix B describes the escrow workflow and a DocuSign flow for activation if required.

Action items for BrightKart:
1) Confirm the three acceptance signals you want included.
2) Confirm whether you want escrow active or keep ephemeral-consignment.
3) Sign the MAP (DocuSign link below) and we’ll schedule the kickoff.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Signing?documentId=0a1b2c3d
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3brightkart-onboarding
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890

I attached: MAP-draft-BK-20270621.pdf and usage_matrix_BK.xlsx (I combined your original matrix with our template).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MAP-draft-BK-20270621.pdf; usage_matrix_BK.xlsx

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightkart.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & onboarding runway (draft) — BrightKart

Thanks Marissa — the draft looks good. Quick answers: 

1) Acceptance signals:
  - MAP@10 improves by >= 6% vs baseline,
  - click-through rate uplift on test cohort >= 3%,
  - no production latency regression > 20ms.

2) We'll keep ephemeral-consignment for now (no escrow).

3) I've routed the MAP to our counsel and signed the DocuSign; you should see a pending signature from BrightKart legal. We'll confirm kickoff next week.

Elena Morales
Sr. Product Manager, BrightKart
elena.morales@brightkart.com
